result.reason: The clause reaches the fallback position: Customer has a convenience-termination right on customer-favorable notice, early-termination charges are capped at three months’ recurring Charges, and prepaid post-termination Charges are refunded. It grants IBM no convenience-termination right. The changes preserve the original scope and prerequisite-attachment limitation. However, the added sentence requiring IBM to continue performing through the termination date is unnecessary because those obligations already continue while the agreement remains effective, and “final termination date” is undefined; accordingly, the redline is not strictly minimal.
